description:
Mini animations featuring characters from the Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! anime posted on the KADOKAWA Anime YouTube channel. These shorts were later released as special features on the Blu-ray and DVD releases of Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute!.

Notes:
- Volume 1 includes Episodes 1-2.
- Volume 2 includes Episodes 3-7.
- Volume 3 includes Episodes 8-12.
- Volume 4 includes Episodes 13-17.
